item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Classic chicken and potato salad. Served with fresh green beans topped with crispy bacon and herbs.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Lechon Kawali, crispy Filipino pork belly, with jasmine rice. Served with ensaladang talong, an aubergine and tomato salad, and liver pâté. GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: sautéed vegetables, with jasmine rice. Served with ensaladang talong, an aubergine and tomato salad, and vegetarian pâté.

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Baked potato filled with slow-roasted smoked beef, corn and cheese. Served with fresh coleslaw. (6) GREEN DISH: Dish Baked potato filled with smoked, spiced tempeh, corn and cheese. Served with fresh coleslaw. (6+7)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Fried chicken burger with a little kick from harissa mayo, salty tang from pickles and crisp crunch from iceberg lettuce. GREEN DISH: Dish Veggie burger with a little kick from harissa mayo, salty tang from pickles and crisp crunch from iceberg lettuce.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Grilled chicken thigh in a crispy tortilla crust with chipotle fries, topped with creamy coleslaw. Served with avocado cream, roasted tomato salsa and lime mayonnaise. (2+6+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Grilled cauliflower in a crispy tortilla crust with chipotle fries, topped with creamy coleslaw. Served with avocado cream, roasted tomato salsa and lime mayonnaise. Also available vegan. (2+6+11+15)
